Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops

Class EOSCGSaturationVUFlash

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.EOSCGSaturationVUFlash
final class EOSCGSaturationVUFlash extends Object
Solves a pure EOS-CG two-phase VU state along its saturation line.
